shop_holiday_rules_hours_check.name: shop_holiday_rules_hours_check
shop_holiday_rules_hours_check.value: ("shop_holiday_rules"."opens" is null and "shop_holiday_rules"."closes" is null) or ("shop_holiday_rules"."opens" is not null and "shop_holiday_rules"."closes" is not null and "shop_holiday_rules"."closes" > "shop_holiday_rules"."opens")

staff_hours_break_check.name: staff_hours_break_check
staff_hours_break_check.value: ("staff_hours"."break_start" is null and "staff_hours"."break_end" is null) or ("staff_hours"."break_start" is not null and "staff_hours"."break_end" is not null and "staff_hours"."break_start" > "staff_hours"."opens" and "staff_hours"."break_end" > "staff_hours"."break_start" and "staff_hours"."break_end" < "staff_hours"."closes")

messages_content_check.name: messages_content_check
messages_content_check.value: "messages"."body" is not null or "messages"."image_path" is not null

reports_target_check.name: reports_target_check
reports_target_check.value: "reports"."booking_id" is not null or "reports"."review_id" is not null

inquiries_contact_check.name: inquiries_contact_check
inquiries_contact_check.value: "inquiries"."email" is not null or "inquiries"."phone" is not null

inquiries_length_check.name: inquiries_length_check
inquiries_length_check.value:
char_length("inquiries"."name") <= 100 and char_length("inquiries"."message") <= 2000
        and coalesce(char_length("inquiries"."email"), 0) <= 200
        and coalesce(char_length("inquiries"."business_name"), 0) <= 150
        and coalesce(char_length("inquiries"."city"), 0) <= 100

booking_policies_ranges_check.name: booking_policies_ranges_check
booking_policies_ranges_check.value: "booking_policies"."cancel_window_hours" between 0 and 168 and "booking_policies"."max_reschedules" between 0 and 10 and "booking_policies"."quote_valid_hours" between 1 and 168 and "booking_policies"."deposit_value" >= 0

services_price_check.name: services_price_check
services_price_check.value: ("services"."price_type" = 'quote' or "services"."price_centavos" is not null) and ("services"."price_centavos" is null or "services"."price_centavos" >= 0)
